description: Python infrastructure provider for Cluster API that bootstraps, manages and safely cleans up pre-provisioned Linux hosts over verified SSH, with persistent ownership and controller HA.
rules: The default Context7 documentation source is main, independently of the GitHub default branch develop. Use a matching release tag and docs/support-matrix.md for version-specific compatibility; repository state and successful CI do not establish a live cluster rollout.

infrastructure.alpininsight.ai/v1beta1 is the provider API group and resource schema version, served by the Kubernetes API server. It is not a provider release number, public website, DNS requirement or CDN location.

The provider implements the legacy v1beta1 CAPI contract. Treat v1beta2 migration, clusterctl packaging and hardware plugins as planned until the support matrix explicitly establishes them as supported.

Use pre-provisioned Linux hosts with independently verified SSH host keys or CA trust. OS and network preparation are prerequisites; this provider does not create cloud VMs, install an OS or manage hardware power.

Follow docs/api-reference.md and shared/crds/ for resource fields. Delete Machines through CAPI; retain claims, quarantine and finalizers until owned cleanup succeeds. Observe durable receipts after unknown outcomes instead of replaying destructive work.

Controller HA uses active/standby peering, host Leases and remote fencing. It does not establish management control-plane HA or a recovery SLO; use docs/operations.md for pause, reboot, cleanup and recovery.

Use docs/installation.md and docs/ssh-key-lifecycle.md for deployment and credential handling. Keep secrets and private inventories out of examples. Internal Python modules are not a supported plugin SDK.
